com.vector.cfg.model.annotation.user

Interface IUserAnnotationList

  • All Superinterfaces:
    java.util.Collection<IUserAnnotation>, com.vector.cfg.model.annotation.IAnnotationAccessor<IUserAnnotation>, IAnnotationList<IUserAnnotation>, java.lang.Iterable<IUserAnnotation>, IViewedModelObject, java.util.List<IUserAnnotation>

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
 @KeepInterfacesSecretFromPublishedApi(value=IAnnotationList.class)
 @NotThreadSafe
public interface IUserAnnotationList
extends java.util.List<IUserAnnotation>, IAnnotationList<IUserAnnotation>
    IUserAnnotationList represents a list of IUserAnnotations with access method to retrieve annotations. See IUserAnnotation.getUserAnnotations(com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.ar4x.genericstructure.generaltemplateclasses.documentation.annotation.MIHasAnnotation) for creation.

    The IUserAnnotationList is updated, when the underlying model changes.

    The IUserAnnotationList is read only list and does not permit any modify operations defined in List, but certain operations like createAndAdd(String) will affect the list content. If you delete a contained IUserAnnotation the list will not be updated.
